shellRecipe:
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-java libtmux-source &&
  git -C libtmux-source checkout be1d62fbaa1aa634c687e1c50bceeb09ef0b8a15

sh run.sh ./libtmux-source/gradlew --project-dir . run \
  -Pexample=Hierarchy --console=plain --max-workers=2

sh run.sh ./libtmux-source/gradlew --project-dir . run \
  -Pexample=Refresh --console=plain --max-workers=2
examples.verificationScope: Each displayed program runs independently with its displayed project, launcher and pinned library. Native checks cover assertions, stdout and cleanup.

shellRecipe:
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-dotnet libtmux-source &&
  git -C libtmux-source checkout 2d99ead5aba8d968e85dcac8c9a9a518452e6ba6

dotnet build Query.fsproj --maxcpucount:1 -p:Example=Hierarchy \
    -p:DisableImplicitLibraryPacksFolder=true \
    -p:RestorePackagesPath="$PWD/.packages" &&
  sh run.sh dotnet run --project Query.fsproj --no-build -p:Example=Hierarchy

dotnet build Query.fsproj --maxcpucount:1 -p:Example=Refresh \
    -p:DisableImplicitLibraryPacksFolder=true \
    -p:RestorePackagesPath="$PWD/.packages" &&
  sh run.sh dotnet run --project Query.fsproj --no-build -p:Example=Refresh
